verdict.rationale: GPT is a closed, API-only model; OpenAI does not release model weights, so no legitimate community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations can exist on public hubs like Hugging Face. The evidence pack (docs, changelog, community threads) contains no mention of any third-party weight derivatives, hub listings, or attribution conventions — only OpenAI's own hosted fine-tuning (SFT/RFT) service, which is not a public derivative ecosystem.
